skills.name: backtesting-frameworks
skills.purpose: Guides building robust backtesting systems for trading strategies, covering look-ahead and survivorship bias, transaction costs, walk-forward and event-driven designs.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when developing or validating trading algorithms or backtest infrastructure; install the quantitative-trading plugin from the wshobson/agents marketplace. Python-oriented, no API keys.
skills.evidence: wshobson/agents 40k stars; ~14k installs (skills.sh via claudemarketplaces), top finance skill by installs; listed on skillsmp (backtest query #4)

skills.name: dcf-model
skills.purpose: Builds a full discounted-cash-flow valuation in Excel: pulls SEC/analyst data, projects cash flows, computes WACC, runs sensitivity tables and outputs a formatted model.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on requests to value a company with a DCF; install the financial-analysis plugin from anthropics/financial-services. Works best with Excel output skills and a data source (SEC filings / MCP data connectors).
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (financial-services plugin marketplace, 38.5k stars, created Feb 2026); ~2k installs

skills.name: comps-analysis
skills.purpose: Produces institutional-grade comparable-company analyses with operating metrics, valuation multiples and statistical benchmarking in spreadsheet form.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on comps / trading multiples / peer benchmarking requests; part of the financial-analysis plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (financial-services plugin marketplace, 38.5k stars, created Feb 2026); ~1.8k installs

skills.name: 3-statement-model
skills.purpose: Completes and populates linked three-statement (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) model templates with correct formulas and checks.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when asked to fill out or finish a 3-statement model template; part of the financial-analysis plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (financial-services plugin marketplace, 38.5k stars, created Feb 2026); ~1.7k installs

skills.name: earnings-analysis
skills.purpose: Writes equity-research earnings update reports analysing quarterly results: beat/miss, key metrics, revised estimates and thesis impact.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers after a company reports earnings and an update note is wanted; install the equity-research plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (financial-services plugin marketplace, 38.5k stars, created Feb 2026); ~2.7k installs (most-installed skill in the repo)

skills.name: vibe-trading
skills.purpose: All-in-one finance research toolkit skill: backtesting across 10 engines, factor analysis with 462 pre-built alphas, options pricing, and orchestration of ~90 bundled finance sub-skills and multi-agent teams.
skills.how_to_use: Use as the entry skill of the Vibe-Trading agent (clone repo, follow its setup); covers stocks, A-shares, crypto. Some data sources need API keys.
skills.evidence: HKUDS (HKU Data Intelligence Lab); 34.4k stars since its April 2026 creation; its sub-skills appear across skillsmp backtest/crypto/earnings searches
skills.notes: Large framework; the SKILL.md lives in agent/ and expects the Vibe-Trading runtime

skills.name: ccxt-python
skills.purpose: Official CCXT skill for Python: connect to 100+ crypto exchanges, fetch market data, place orders, stream tickers/order books over WebSocket, handle auth and errors.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when writing Python code against crypto exchanges with CCXT; sibling skills exist for TS, Go, Java, PHP, C#, Rust and the CLI. Exchange API keys needed for trading.
skills.evidence: Official, inside the ccxt/ccxt repo (44k stars); ~1.3k installs
skills.notes: Placing real orders moves real funds; use exchange sandboxes

skills.name: risk-metrics-calculation
skills.purpose: Calculates portfolio risk metrics (VaR, CVaR, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown) and patterns for risk limits and monitoring.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when measuring portfolio risk or building risk dashboards; part of the quantitative-trading plugin.
skills.evidence: wshobson/agents 40k stars; ~9k installs

skills.name: lbo-model
skills.purpose: Completes leveraged-buyout model templates in Excel for private-equity deals: sources and uses, debt schedules, returns, with validation and formatting.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on LBO model requests; part of the financial-analysis plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (financial-services plugin marketplace, 38.5k stars, created Feb 2026); ~1.6k installs

skills.name: initiating-coverage
skills.purpose: Runs a 5-step workflow (research, model, valuation, charts, report) to produce a full institutional initiation-of-coverage report.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when asked to initiate coverage on a stock; run tasks in order as the skill instructs; part of the equity-research plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (financial-services plugin marketplace, 38.5k stars, created Feb 2026); ~1.6k installs
skills.notes: Long multi-step workflow; heavy token use

skills.name: merger-model
skills.purpose: Builds M&A accretion/dilution analysis: pro forma EPS impact, synergy sensitivities and purchase-price allocation in Excel.
skills.how_to_use: Use when evaluating an acquisition or preparing merger consequences for a pitch; works with the xlsx tooling in the plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic financial-services plugins, 38.5k stars
skills.notes: Fills the M&A gap next to dcf/lbo/comps already listed.

skills.name: financial-statements
skills.purpose: Generates income statement, balance sheet and cash-flow statements with period-over-period comparison and material-variance flags for month/quarter close.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on P&L / close / budget-vs-actual requests; install the finance plugin from anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic knowledge-work plugins (26k stars); ~3.7k installs

skills.name: startup-financial-modeling

skills.evidence: wshobson/agents 40k stars; ~10k installs

skills.name: options-strategy-advisor
skills.purpose: Options strategy analysis and simulation with Black-Scholes pricing, Greeks, P/L diagrams for spreads, covered calls, protective puts and risk guidance.

skills.evidence: tradermonty 2.9k stars; ~1.7k installs

skills.name: okx-cex-market

skills.notes: Executes real trades; regional availability and ToS apply

skills.name: alpaca-trading-backtest
skills.purpose: Official Alpaca skill for deterministic, reproducible historical backtests using the Alpaca CLI plus agent-written strategy code, returning trades and diagnostics.
